en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Talha Bin Zayd, 
(The narrator says) ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, saying that
Allah Mighty and Majestic Hates every frequent divorcer, the taster’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Talhah ibn Zayd who has said the following: “I once heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘
Allah hates those who divorce very often in big haste (like an epicure who keeps tasting this and that food).”’
